<!-- Generated by tools/vxrt_agents.py from .agents/commands/vxrt-games.md — edit that, then run tools/vxrt_agents.py sync. -->
Show the user the state of Skyrim VR in the vxrt harness. Read only: do not run the game, do not change files.

1. Get the profile with the vxrt MCP `list_games` (or `python3 tools/vxrt_run.py --list` and `python3 tools/vxrt_games.py list`).
2. Report: install state, profile status and summary, known issues, the scenarios and their baselines, the settings tuned for this Mac if any. Add the newest run in `runs/*/result.json` (run_id, status, level, pairs_per_s_median), and say when there is none. Every harness run is the Mac dev host, never a headset.
3. End with what the user can ask next: `/vxrt-support`, `/vxrt-tune`, `/vxrt-issue`.
